serviceContent.title: Feature
serviceContent.description: Layers of protection for every rupee that leaves your company

salesFeature.subtitle: Intelligent Data Capture
salesFeature.title: Capture Vendor Bills Instantly
description: Bills are uploaded directly. The system reads them accurately — GSTIN, Date, Tax, PO, Amount.
No typing, no delays, no mistakes.

salesFeature.subtitle: Vendor GSTIN Validation
salesFeature.title: Avoid Bad Vendors Before Booking Bills
description: Effortless checks on vendor GST return status and claim history.
The system blocks bills if the GST is inactive.
You stay compliant before the bill gets approved.

salesFeature.subtitle: Happy Employees, Happy Finance
salesFeature.title: Employee Claims, Without Follow-ups
description: Employees upload travel, food, and petty cash bills from the mobile app.
Policy checks run automatically — daily limits, category limits, receipt requirements.
Finance sees and approves faster because rules already applied.

salesFeature.subtitle: No More Chasing
salesFeature.title: The Approval Flow That Runs Itself
description: Rules decide who needs to approve — manager, finance, or head office.
Everyone sees the complete motion — who approved, who rejected, why.

salesFeature.subtitle: Right Payments, No Surprises
salesFeature.title: The CFO’s Payment Stack
description: Approved bills and reimbursements land in a single queue.
Finance can run payments in batches or approve individually.
One dashboard, zero errors, zero confusion.

salesFeature.subtitle: The Final Truth Remains True
salesFeature.title: Tally Always Updated. Always.
description: Approved bills, payments, and journals move into Tally without retyping.
Master data sync, record-keeping stays clean, and audits stay smooth.

salesFeature.subtitle: Transparency Metrics
salesFeature.title: Every Rupee. One View.
description: A real-time dashboard shows:
Total vendor bills
Total employee claims
Pending approvals
Bank-wise and department-wise spend
Budget vs actual
Everything can be exported instantly for audit or monthly close.
